editorial.blurb: A spirited bar and restaurant where carefully crafted burgers and cocktails draw crowds night after night, backed by the same attention to detail that defines the acclaimed kitchen upstairs.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive without a reservation on a busy Saturday night and ask the exceptionally kind hosts about bar seating—they'll get you settled quickly and you'll snag some of the best seats in the house with a view of the action.
